summary: Model updated for the NEWLEADER/UPTODATE change (packet-level learner sync, INITIAL server state); harness rebased; 7 fresh traces validated; model checking found 3 real defects: an update-introduced NPE (MC-1), NEWLEADER ACK before durability (MC-2, pre-existing, narrowed) and loss of a committed transaction after a learner fails in INITIAL and re-elects in-process (MC-3).
validation_limits: All BFS campaigns stopped at their per-run time budget with non-empty queues (bounded exploration, not proof): 3 servers, 1 transaction, MaxEpoch 2-3, bounded crash/drop/snapshot.
Deep update paths (U-EPOCH no-crash, U-LOSS) were reached with guidance constraints that only restrict the full MCNext.
Leader-side LearnerHandler packet production is not instrumented; Trace.tla supplies the consumed packet (TraceDeliverPacket).
MC-2's data-loss consequence needs a process crash inside the ACK-to-fsync window, which the in-JVM test harness cannot inject.
The specula CLI (ci-result, persistent findings registry) is not installed in this environment; reports were written manually.

findings.title: NullPointerException when a COMMIT crosses NEWLEADER
findings.cause: The update clears packetsNotCommitted at NEWLEADER, but the unchanged COMMIT handler dereferences packetsNotCommitted.peekFirst() (Learner.java:645-646).
findings.trigger: A learner joins an established leader with an outstanding proposal (forwarded before NEWLEADER by startForwarding) whose COMMIT is forwarded after NEWLEADER.
findings.consequence: The learner throws NullPointerException after ACKing NEWLEADER, aborts synchronisation, leaks its INITIAL-state processors and retries; under write load it may never rejoin.

findings.title: NEWLEADER ACKed and currentEpoch persisted before the synchronised history is durable
findings.cause: setCurrentEpoch precedes logging and the update only enqueues the DIFF proposals (logRequest) before writing the NEWLEADER ACK; the fsync happens later in SyncRequestProcessor.
findings.trigger: A learner ACKs NEWLEADER of a new epoch whose history it received by DIFF and crashes before SyncRequestProcessor forces it; the old leader then fails.
findings.consequence: The crashed learner restarts with the new epoch but without the history; FLE prefers its epoch, so it can lead and truncate a committed transaction.

findings.title: Stale tree after a failure in the new INITIAL state; in-process re-election loses a committed transaction
findings.cause: A learner failing between NEWLEADER and UPTODATE is in State.INITIAL, where ZooKeeperServer/LearnerZooKeeperServer.shutdown are no-ops, so its tree is not fast-forwarded while currentEpoch already advanced.
findings.trigger: Learners ACK NEWLEADER (the leader establishes and serves the DIFF transaction), time out on UPTODATE, the leader fails and the learners re-elect without a process restart.
findings.consequence: The new leader establishes an epoch without the committed transaction; a znode a client read from the old leader is missing after failover.
